d:
An avian humanoid species with deep crimson plumage and cream-colored accents on the legs. It possesses a small tuft of electric yellow feathers on its head and three long, flowing deep crimson feathers trailing from its crown. It has sharp, narrow amber eyes and three claws on each hand. The body is athletic and lean with large, orange-hot flame plumes emerging from its wrists.
BODY COLOR: deep crimson
